   OCBC mobile, internet banking services restored after disruption: Spokesperson
 Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox
 OCBC’s mobile app and internet banking services appeared to be disrupted on the afternoon of Oct 23.
 ST PHOTO: CHONG JUN LIANG
 Calista Wong
 Published   Oct 23, 2026, 02:52 PM
 Updated   Oct 23, 2026, 03:28 PM
 Set as preferred source Listen SINGAPORE - Some OCBC customers faced difficulties accessing the bank’s mobile and internet banking services on the afternoon of Oct 23, with affected services since restored, the bank said.
 According to outage-tracking website Downdetector, the issue began at about 12.15pm, peaking at over 767 reports at about 1.11pm.
The number of reports has dipped since, to about 71 at 2.56pm .
 An error message displayed on the OCBC mobile banking app.
 PHOTO: ST READER
 In a media reply, an OCBC spokesperson said: “Some customers faced intermittent slowness accessing our mobile and internet banking services earlier this afternoon.
 “Our ATM and card services are not affected. We assure customers that their monies are safe and no customer data is compromised. We apologise for the inconvenience and would like to thank our customers for their patience and understanding.”
 An announcement on the OCBC app said: “You may have difficulty accessing the OCBC app and Internet Banking. We are sorry for the inconvenience and are working to bring things back to normal.”
 On social media, a user reported issues with log-in functions, while others said they were having problems with ATM withdrawals and PayNow services.
